sloka: दिष्ट्या ऽसि दर्शनं राम मम त्वं प्राप्तवानिह।काङ्क्षितो ऽसि क्षुधार्तस्य सिंहस्येवेतरो मृगः ।। ६.७९.१३ ।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā 'si darśanaṁ rāma mama tvaṁ prāptavāniha।kāṅkṣito 'si kṣudhārtasya siṁhasyevetaro mṛgaḥ ।। 6.79.13 ।।

translations.english: "Rama! To my good fortune it became possible for me to see you here. Just as a hungry lion waits for an animal, I am waiting for you."
